source: Chains operating in Malta not covered by chains-burgers.json or chains-other.json, from official nutrition tables of other EU markets because the Malta sites publish none: KFC Poland's nutrition table (AmRest, 29.09.2026) for the KFC items sold in Malta, and Domino's Cyprus's nutritional and allergen tables (dominos.com.cy) for the Domino's pizzas sold in Malta.
